name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd.
about: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells lead-acid storage batteries for industrial and automotive applications in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Lead Acid Batteries and Allied Products; and New Energy Business. The company provides new energy business related products; installation, commissioning, and maintenance services; and industrial chargers, integrated power systems, electric charging solutions, and battery energy storage systems, as well as lithium-based home UPS systems and hybrid inverter platforms for residential and small commercial applications. It also develops, manufactures, and sells energy storage and management products, solutions, and technologies related to lithium cells, advanced cell chemistries, battery packs, and components.
